mapper.select: SELECT * FROM com_sales_order_line WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM com_contract c JOIN com_project_contract_relation r ON r.contract_id=c.id AND r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id WHERE c.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND r.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND c.contract_no=#{query.contractNo} AND c.deleted=b'0' AND r.deleted=b'0' AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND (r.effective_from IS NULL OR r.effective_from <= #{query.at}) AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > #{query.at})

SELECT id FROM com_sales_order WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND (source_system='ERP' OR (source_system IN ('SAP','D365','SMS') AND source_record_key LIKE CONCAT('DPPMS|',source_system,'|%'))) AND source_record_key=#{query.sourceKey} AND deleted=b'0'

SELECT id FROM com_sales_order_line WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND (source_system='ERP' OR (source_system IN ('SAP','D365','SMS') AND source_record_key LIKE CONCAT('DPPMS|',source_system,'|%'))) AND source_record_key=#{query.sourceKey} AND deleted=b'0'

SELECT id FROM com_crm_execution_order WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND source_system=#{query.sourceSystem} AND execution_no=#{query.executionNo} AND primary_project_id=#{query.projectId} AND deleted=b'0'
SELECT id FROM com_shipment_package WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND source_system='DPPMS' AND package_no=#{query.packageNo} AND deleted=b'0'

SELECT DISTINCT o.id FROM com_sales_order o JOIN com_contract c ON c.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND c.deleted=0 AND c.contract_no=#{query.contractNo} JOIN com_project_contract_relation pcr ON pcr.contract_id=c.id AND pcr.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND pcr.deleted=0 WHERE o.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND pcr.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND o.deleted=0 AND o.status='ENABLED' AND (o.source_system='ERP' OR o.source_system=#{query.source}) AND o.order_no=#{query.number} AND o.order_type=#{query.type} AND pcr.status='ACTIVE' AND (pcr.effective_from IS NULL OR pcr.effective_from <= #{query.at}) AND (pcr.effective_to IS NULL OR pcr.effective_to > #{query.at}) AND ( (CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY)=CAST(c.contract_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY)=CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_order_contract_relation r WHERE r.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND r.order_id=o.id AND r.contract_id=c.id AND r.deleted=0 AND r.effective_from <= #{query.at} AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > #{query.at})) ) AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY)=CAST(#{query.companyCode} AS BINARY)
AND (o.source_record_key=CONCAT('DPPMS|',#{query.source},'|',#{query.companyCode},'|',#{query.type},'|',#{query.number}) OR o.source_record_key=CONCAT('DPPMS|',#{query.source},'|',#{query.rawCompanyCode},'|',#{query.type},'|',#{query.number}))

SELECT id FROM com_sales_order_line WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND order_id=#{query.orderId} AND line_no=#{query.lineNo} AND deleted=0 AND (source_system='ERP' OR (source_system IN ('SAP','D365','SMS') AND source_record_key LIKE CONCAT('DPPMS|',source_system,'|%')))
